data.gender_notes: Juwairiyat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who keeps the garden or cultivates flowers. The name Juwairiyat carries the meaning “Gardener, Flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Juwairiyat usually hope their child will grow to embody gardener, flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Juwairiyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardener, Flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Juwairiyat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: جويرية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من جوير، يعني الصغيرة أو القليلة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جويرية مشتق من الجويرة، و هي تصغير جارية أو جور، و يعني الصغيرة أو القليلة، و يرمز إلى الفتاة الصغيرة أو المميزة في جمالها و أخلاقها، و يعتبر من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: جویریہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: جویریہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے چھوٹی یا خوبصورت لڑکی، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور پاکیزگی کی علامت ہے، اور اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے

in_hindi.name: जुवैरियत
in_hindi.long_meaning: जुवैरियत नाम का अर्थ है छोटी या सुंदर लड़की, यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में सुंदरता और पवित्रता का प्रतीक है, और यह नाम मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत पसंद किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: جويريه

in_english.name: Juwairiyat
in_english.long_meaning: Juwairiyat is a female given name derived from the Arabic root 'jw-r', meaning small, little or beautiful girl, it symbolizes a person with a gentle and kind nature, and is considered a blessed name in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name Juwairiyat holds a significant impact in Islamic culture as it is associated with the historical figure of Juwairiyah bint al-Harith, a strong and courageous woman who fought alongside her husband, Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the early Muslim community in the Battle of Mu'tah against the Byzantine and Lakhmid forces in the late 7th century AD. Her name reflects her role as a protector of gardens and her steadfastness in defending Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Juwairiyat can be seen as a reminder of the importance of patience, endurance, and nurturing in the journey of life. It can also suggest the role of individuals as cultivators of their own spiritual gardens, striving to preserve and transform themselves into a beautiful and virtuous being through acts of worship, prayer, kindness, and good deeds.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gardener, Flower" symbolizes She who keeps the garden or cultivates flowers. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Juwairiyat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gardener, flower.

historical_references.reference: Juwairiyat was a female companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She was known for her generosity and hospitality towards the Prophet and his companions.
